status: complete: exactly two ordinary terminal attempts

method.discovery: Driver --help protocol, visible title, Operator Handbook, facility map, screenshots and visible HUD only. No source, helper implementation, prior reports, debug state or arranged encounters.
method.controls: Pause-assisted browser-timed synthetic inputs; automatic Escape pauses between batches.
method.limitations: Not human enjoyment, audio, latency or hardware certification. Pauses provide extra decision time, while long synthetic batches impede continuous correction. No tests/build/game edits.

evidence.screenshots: All original captures retained, including misses, unsuccessful holds, wall collisions and both losses.

first_friction.description: My first attempted shot correction toward the west-archive sentinel failed to eliminate it: after 22 rounds and lateral travel I still had only the induction kill and lost shield from 60 to 24. Aiming at the small moving optic while translating required finer correction than I managed. This is observed friction, not proof of faulty hit detection.

outcomes.custodian: Coils I and II visibly OFF; III 100% at last playing capture. Defeat not achieved.
outcomes.trajectory: Induction critical kill; west archive recovery; unsuccessful Heart hold at 6m, another at 3.2m / 0.4m outside reach; small step and recovery; east recovery; architecture corrections while returning south; two coils disabled; died while reloading/repositioning for third.

Induction critical kill; attempted east route instead of west. Long movement met walls repeatedly. Two E holds out of reach recovered nothing. Corrections returned near central entry, losing health under patrol fire. Selected breacher but fired only during final push; died before meaningful weapon comparison.

strengths.observation: Rain, reflective paving, restrained cyan/amber lighting and large station signage create a coherent drowned industrial place.
Objective recovery is visibly acknowledged with filled numbered slots, a named memory card, supplies, and a new target; all three worked in the first attempt.
The near-receiver UI gave actionable reach information: 0.4m outside reach explained the failed hold, and one short correction succeeded.
Custodian component numbers, copper exposed cells and dark disabled housings made progressive damage tangible. The HUD tracked I and II OFF.
Death screen clearly reports time, score and accuracy and offers an immediately usable redeploy.

objections.observation: Route interpretation remained costly. Distance markers identify destinations but do not by themselves resolve architecture; my southward return hit two large surfaces, and second-attempt east traversal repeatedly failed. Map and Tab trace existed, but I did not use them consistently enough to establish whether they would solve every correction.

Encounter pressure continued during stationary objective holds and boss reloads. I recovered memories but exposed myself to patrols and died before the third coil; pressure was clear, my safe firing-position understanding was incomplete.

Small monospaced microcopy, multiple translucent readouts and occasional text over signs reduce glance readability, particularly the signal distance near the minimap and boss announcement under the boss panel.
The handbook is very dense for first-contact onboarding. It explains many conditional systems before I have seen them; I could not demonstrate most in two attempts.

anchors.1: Observed experience repeatedly prevents basic play
anchors.2: Functional core with substantial friction in observed play
anchors.3: Coherent playable slice with meaningful limitations
anchors.4: Strong execution across observed situations with minor friction
anchors.5: Exceptional execution across broad observed coverage

rating_scale.qualification: Scores are judgments from these two losses, not certification or a target; unobserved systems do not receive inferred credit.

gameplay.rationale: Functional recovery-to-boss escalation, critical induction kill and two disabled coils. Persistent patrol pressure creates stakes, but my combat and route control were brittle; no full mission completion.

presentation.rationale: Consistent storm station art direction, atmospheric reflections and typography; visible geometry remains spare/blocky. Audio not evaluated.

usability.rationale: Clear deploy/redeploy, map and recovery reach feedback; dense handbook and repeated failed route choices leave onboarding improvement room.

readability.rationale: Large objectives, optic/coil color coding and physical numerals communicate well; small layered text and direction cues demanded attention under fire.

AAA readiness.rationale: Promising coherent vertical slice with working progression and retry, but these two losses do not establish final encounter/extraction quality, breadth, accessibility, audio, performance or production robustness. Observed navigation and HUD density still introduce friction.

observed: Rifle ADS/fire/reload and induction critical elimination
One lateral Soul Shift during first attempt and final push Shift in second; no recorded evade
Three memory recoveries and two out-of-reach Heart holds
Patrol fire, directional warnings, shield regeneration and health loss
Custodian activation and two disabled numbered coils
Breacher selection and brief terminal firing
